The '''outermost moon''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]] was a large chunk of rock which orbited the planet at a great distance. The [[Moon/Legends|moon]] had been partially destroyed during a conflict prior to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] and by this time retired [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Morga Bunna]] opened up a [[Morga Bunna's supply depot|supply depot]] on the moon.
